context.requirement_text: REQ-204: SSRF validation for webhook target_url. See lib/letflow/design/req204-ssrf-validation.md for the full design. Implement the design exactly: (1) new Letflow.Webhooks.UrlValidator module at lib/letflow/webhooks/url_validator.ex with @moduledoc stating exact blocked ranges as Letflow own choice; (2) validate/1 (production) and validate/2 (test-injectable dns_resolver) entry points; (3) call to UrlValidator.validate/1 in create/2 before the with block, returning {:error, :target_url_not_allowed}; (4) call to UrlValidator.validate/1 in dispatch_http/3 before :httpc.request/4, returning {:FAILED, nil, 'target_url not allowed (SSRF protection)'} on rejection; (5) add INV-9 to docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md.

task.description: Implement REQ-204 per the design at lib/letflow/design/req204-ssrf-validation.md. Files to create/modify: (1) NEW lib/letflow/webhooks/url_validator.ex; (2) MODIFY lib/letflow/webhooks.ex (add UrlValidator.validate/1 call in create/2 and in dispatch_http/3); (3) MODIFY docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md (add INV-9 per §5 of design). No migration. Run mix compile --warnings-as-errors after implementation to confirm it compiles clean.
acceptance_criteria: lib/letflow/webhooks/url_validator.ex exists with @moduledoc stating exact blocked ranges as Letflow's own choice
validate/2 accepts custom dns_resolver for testability
blocked_ipv6?/1 covers ::1/128, fc00::/7, and IPv4-mapped forms
create/2 in lib/letflow/webhooks.ex calls UrlValidator.validate before Multi.new, returns {:error, :target_url_not_allowed} on rejection
dispatch_http/3 in lib/letflow/webhooks.ex calls UrlValidator.validate before :httpc.request, returns {:FAILED, nil, 'target_url not allowed (SSRF protection)'} on rejection
INV-9 added to docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md following existing Rule/Reference/How to verify/Severity format

notes: Design referenced &:inet.getaddrinfo/1 (OTP stdlib) which does not exist. Used :inet.getaddrs/2 for both :inet and :inet6 families via a private resolve_all/1 and a @doc false public default_resolver/1 in UrlValidator. The public function is needed so webhooks.ex can form a function reference &UrlValidator.default_resolver/1 for dispatch_http/3's delegation to dispatch_http/4 — without it Elixir would warn on an unused private dispatch_http/4.
fc00::/7 check implemented as `when a in 0xFC00..0xFDFF` guard (no Bitwise import needed for that clause). Bitwise imported for >>> and &&& in ipv4_from_mapped_ipv6/1.
OQ-1 (fe80::/10 IPv6 link-local not in blocklist): flagged for REVIEWER. Not silently added.

dispatch_http/4 added and IS called by dispatch_http/3 (which delegates to it with &UrlValidator.default_resolver/1). Test injection for AC4 DNS-rebinding available via dispatch_http/4 if TEST-DESIGNER threads dns_resolver through attempt_loop/deliver — or tests can call UrlValidator.validate/2 directly for the DNS-rebinding unit coverage.
